quote: we propose Adversarial Text Generation (ATG) to relate dementia detection with other tasks... ATG generates a human-understandable Feature Context
We propose Adversarial Text Generation (ATG) to relate dementia detection with other tasks that LLM may be capable of, with the guidance of the training set.

ATG is a perplexity-based decoding strategy inspired by previous studies using perplexity for dementia detection. As shown in Figure, given a training set and an instruction, ATG generates a human-understandable Feature Context, which could be used for perplexity-based classification.

quote: We report the PPL-S (P-S), ACC(%), and AUC(%)...
We use PPL-S + ACC as the main PPL metric and report ACC and AUC for both training and testing.
For each c_{n+1}, we calculate the PPL-F value as the difference of the mean perplexity score of two classes, i.e., mean(PPL_M(D_d^train, I, C_n||c_{n+1}))-mean(PPL_M(D_h^train, I, C_n||c_{n+1})).
